ledger.claim: The route deviation is ESTABLISHED on this trip's own trace. Both POL-RD-01 gates are cleared: the excess is greater than 0.8 km in absolute terms and greater than 20% of optimal, and both tests must pass, so a deviation exists. POL-RD-01 makes gps_trace.trace_distance_km the governing field where it disagrees with the rounded trip_record.actual_distance_km (22.9 km), and on the trace figure the excess is 6.25 km, not the smaller figure the convenience copy would give.

The rider's initial burden under POL-RD-08 is discharged. The trip_record, gps_trace and fare_breakdown all carry trip_id TRP-02830, and the trace's first fix at 17:08:27 matches trip_record.started_at, so limb (a) is satisfied. Limb (b) is satisfied by a 6.25 km excess measured from a gps_trace that is unimpaired under POL-RD-07. rider_profile.deviation_claims_60d is 1, well below the 4-claim trigger, so no corroboration beyond the trace is required of this rider; and POL-GEN-01 confines the profile to the tests that name its fields, which that field does not here.

The trace is clean, so the driver cannot retreat into the impaired-trace rules. EV-GPS-02830 carries 181 fixes at a 10 second sample interval over 100.0% coverage, with zero gaps and max_gap_sec of 0.0. It meets none of POL-RD-07(a) to (c) - no gap above 90 seconds, no straight-line jump above 500 m, no sustained interval above 30 seconds - so the deviation may be established on the trace alone and POL-RD-10(3), which escalates an impaired trace lacking independent corroboration, is not engaged.

The driver's traffic excuse carries no weight on this record. The counterparty_statement blames 'a massive jam on the expressway', but the bundle holds no traffic_advisory for this trip: EV-ADVIS-02830-01 is MISSING with weight_multiplier 0.0 and issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, and I disclose that impairment and cite the identifier for its absence. POL-RD-13 requires the traffic assertion to be tested against the traffic_advisory and nothing else; with no advisory on file the POL-RD-03 comparison cannot be run, POL-RD-03 is unavailable, and the assertion carries no weight under POL-RD-08. Because the driver names no evidence identifier for any advisory, this is a gap in the bundle rather than an exculpatory clause invoked against a cited artifact, so POL-RD-13(1) keeps POL-RD-10(5) from firing and the case does not escalate on that ground.

No rider instruction can excuse any part of the route. The chat_log for this trip is empty - message_count 0, first_message_at and last_message_at both null, and trip_record.chat_message_count confirms it - so there is no rider message, no waypoint_hint and no requested road. The excess is measured against the ordinary 16.7 km optimal and stands at 6.25 km.

ruling.explanation:
To both parties: the charge for trip TRP-02830 is partly refunded. Distance. The GPS trace EV-GPS-02830 measures 22.95 km between the recorded pickup and dropoff against a booked optimal route of 16.7 km on the trip record EV-TRIP-02830. The excess is 6.25 km, or 37.4%, and both POL-RD-01 establishment tests pass (over 0.8 km and over 20% of optimal), so a route deviation is established on the trace figure, which POL-RD-01 makes governing over the rounded 22.9 km convenience copy. Neither materiality test is met (6.25 km is below 8.0 km; 37.4% is below 50%), so this is not a MATERIAL deviation, the POL-RD-06 driver-profile check is not engaged, and no POL-RD-06(b) uplift or POL-RD-06(c) conduct referral arises. For completeness, the two counters POL-RD-06 names show no pattern in any event (deviation_flags_90d of 1 against completed_trips_90d of 395, a rate of 0.0025), and the lifetime counter prior_deviation_flags is context only under POL-GEN-01 and was not used. The trace is unimpaired on the policy test as well as the schema test: 181 fixes at a 10 s interval, 100% coverage, no gaps and a maximum inter-fix gap of 0.0 s, so none of POL-RD-07(a) to (c) fires and the POL-RD-10(3) escalation route is closed. Refund. The fare breakdown EV-FARE-02830 shows a METERED fare, so POL-RD-02 applies. charged_total is 30.18. recomputed_fare = (3.80 + 0.75 x 16.7 + 0.28 x 22.5) x the surge multiplier of 1.0 read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier, plus the 0.80 platform fee, with no ERP, tolls, fixed surcharge, waiting-time fee or promo discount = 23.425. Refund = 30.18 - 23.425 = 6.755, rounded UP to a payable SGD 6.80. That is above the SGD 0.50 de minimis floor and 22.4% of charged_total, far below the 90% share that would convert the outcome to a full refund, so the result is PARTIAL_REFUND of SGD 6.80 against the 8.50 claimed. Pass-through lines. POL-RD-09 adds and subtracts nothing: erp_lines total 0.00 with no off-optimal-route gantry charged, no tolls, no waiting-time fee, and no airport surcharge because this trip ends at Blk 420 Woodlands St 41 and does not originate at an airport. There is no phantom or unmatched charge line, so no POL-RD-09(4) billing-integrity referral arises. The driver's traffic explanation. The driver's account of a jam on the expressway is discarded. The bundle holds no traffic advisory for this trip: EV-ADVIS-02830-01 is MISSING with weight_multiplier 0.0 and issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT (no advisory covers the Blk 640 Jurong West St 61 corridor in this window). Under POL-RD-13 and POL-RD-08 the assertion cannot be tested, POL-RD-03 is unavailable, and the excuse carries no weight. Because the driver names no advisory evidence ID, POL-RD-13(1) keeps POL-RD-10(5) from firing: this is a gap in the bundle, not an exculpatory clause invoked against a cited artifact, so the case is decided on the measured excess and money moves rather than being held. Other routes out. POL-RD-04 gives the driver nothing: the chat log EV-CHAT-02830 is empty (0 messages, both timestamps null), so there is no rider instruction, waypoint or requested road, and POL-RD-14 has nothing to operate on. POL-RD-05 gives no re-quote: pickup_amended_at and dropoff_amended_at are null and amended_optimal_distance_km is null, so the booked 16.7 km optimal governs. POL-RD-12 does not apply: vehicle_type is RYDE_X, not RYDE_POOL, and solo_optimal_distance_km is null. No POL-RD-10 trigger fires and no referral is produced by any clause. The ruling rests on artifacts all at weight 1.0, so confidence is 0.95. The monetary effect of SGD 6.80 is at or below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold, so this provisional ruling is executed automatically. This ruling was made without human review; either party may appeal it once within 30 days under POL-GEN-04.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).
